title: Laundry Appliance Maintenance: Hoses, Venting, Lint, and Smart Diagnostics
summary: This episode of Ask This Old House presents practical, experience-based guidance for maintaining laundry appliances. Home expert Richie Isaacson outlines preventive measures to avoid floods and fires, focusing on washer hose health, proper loading, and detergent choices, followed by dryer maintenance. Key recommendations include upgrading to stainless steel braided washer hoses and replacing them every five years, avoiding overloading the washer, removing items from pockets, understanding top-load versus front-load designs, using high-efficiency detergent in HE machines, mitigating vibration with a dedicated pad and ensuring the unit is level, and rigorous dryer lint and vent maintenance. The segment also compares venting options (vinyl, aluminum, and solid pipe), notes that solid pipe is preferred by manufacturers, and emphasizes annual vent cleaning. The host team closes with a nod to emerging smart-diagnosis tools that acoustically or app-diagnose issues, illustrated by a dryer vent blockage detected via an app and a washer’s audible-diagnosis feature.
